text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before the Arima Kinen main event. Tamamo 
Cross leisurely inspects the track, 
displaying an unusual level of composure.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It was unmistakably proof of maturity. Her 
rivals were utterly overwhelmed by the 
perfected sharpness of Tamamo Cross.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is her last run. Tamamo Cross charges 
ahead with high spirits, ready to unleash 
the lightning bolt of a lifetime.
